text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume grow substantially in the summer."
There is such a saying in the racing world.
Summer achievements greatly affect autumn results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During such a pivotal summer, in order to foster their growth... Tracen Academy holds a large-scale training camp every year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> will surely experience great growth as well.
—Especially now that we have such a dependable helper.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's the training camp lodge!
Brings back memories♪

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
This place never changes...
choice_data_list: I never expected you'd be able to come to the summer training camp too!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We know all too well
just how crucial the summer is, after all.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll stay by your side until the very end.
Don't hesitate to rely on me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Every one of those legends must be busy in their own right... but their kindness in making time for their juniors warms the heart.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Speed Symboli-san,
would you like to look around the camp grounds before training?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I wonder if our doodles from back then are still there~♪

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh, seems you were quite the little troublemaker, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We still have time left, too...
All right, time to reconvene the survey team.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Yay♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Come to think of it, where is St Lite?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: —Ladies and gentlemen.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Could you gather the children for me? Some refreshments have arrived.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
—Around 10,000 milk ice creams, please.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: A scorching summer training camp calls for some refreshments, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Here's some for you too, <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"She is such a very
lovely girl, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"I have
very high hopes for you."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to what lies ahead.
—Here, have another ice cream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
St Lite is cheering us on, too.
For the sake of <chrname>'s growth...
Let's make this a passionate summer camp!
